close_reason: Not a bug: delta issuer check against cert.issuer is equivalent to checking against base issuer (base issuer == cert issuer already verified at step 2). Both paths are correct.
description:
**Bug**: In check_revocation at crl.rs:230, the delta CRL's issuer is validated against `cert.tbs_certificate.issuer` (the certificate being checked). But RFC 5280 §5.2.4 says a delta CRL MUST be signed by the same CA that issued the base CRL — so the issuer check should compare the delta's issuer against the **base CRL's issuer**, not the cert's issuer.

In the common case these are the same value (cert issuer == base CRL issuer, already validated at line 166). But they diverge for indirect CRLs (where the CRL issuer differs from the cert issuer) or in error cases where someone passes a mismatched base+cert combination to check_revocation.

More specifically: with_delta validates at construction time (line 136) that base_crl.issuer == delta_crl.issuer. And check_revocation validates at line 166 that base_crl.issuer == cert.issuer. So transitively, delta_crl.issuer == cert.issuer. The check at line 230 is thus redundant with the construction-time check — it would only fire in a situation that's already been ruled out.

**However**: The with_delta construction check is fine, but CrlChecker::new + check_revocation can receive a delta via delta_crl_der even though new() doesn't set it. The only path to delta_crl_der is through with_delta, which does the construction-time check. So in practice this is unreachable.

**Real issue**: The code at line 230 says 'Verify delta CRL issuer matches the certificate's issuer' — this is checking the wrong thing (cert issuer vs delta issuer). RFC 5280 requires checking the delta issuer against the base issuer. The variable available is the already-parsed base `crl.tbs_cert_list.issuer`. The current check happens to be equivalent due to the construction invariant, but it's semantically incorrect per the RFC and misleading in the comment.

**Location**: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:229-232\n\n**Fix**: Change line 230 to compare `delta_crl.tbs_cert_list.issuer` against `crl.tbs_cert_list.issuer` (the base CRL's issuer) instead of `cert.tbs_certificate.issuer`. Update the comment to cite RFC 5280 §5.2.4 correctly.
title: crl.rs: base/delta issuer check uses cert issuer not base issuer
